subject: Partner empanelment & toolchain onboarding: Blue Ridge Consulting
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@blueridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <e.park@blueridge.com>, Blue Ridge Consulting Partner Ops <partner-ops@blueridge.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner empanelment + tooling access (BRC x Redwood)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Blue Ridge is finalizing our 2026 SI roster and we would like Redwood to be empaneled as a preferred inference platform for our consulting engagements.

Primary asks to start the process:
- A short empanelment questionnaire or checklist we can use internally
- A standard SOW template and indicative pricing bands for integration/POC work
- Sandbox access and a short operations runbook our field engineers can use for hands-on labs

Can we schedule a 45m intake session next week to capture the enablement scope and timeline? Target audience: 3 PM engineers + 2 solution architects.

Attachments: BR-Redwood-Empanelment-Request.pdf (internal form)

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Partnerships, Blue Ridge Consulting
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@blueridge.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2025 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner empanelment + tooling access (BRC x Redwood)

Thanks Samir — this sounds great. Happy to kick off the intake.

Proposed 45m agenda (we can tighten if you like):
1) Intro + goals (5m)
2) Empanelment asks & questionnaire walkthrough (10m)
3) Toolchain & sandbox access (SSO/SCIM, service accounts, region choices) (10m)
4) Training plan options (self-serve labs, 1-2 day bootcamp, shadow rotations) (10m)
5) Next steps / SOW & timeline (10m)

Logs / things we need from you before the meeting:
- Names + emails of the engineers who need sandbox access (we'll provision temporary creds)
- Preferred cloud region (us-west/us-east/eu-central) for integration testing
- Any procurement constraints or procurement contact for SOW routing (PO vs. credit card vs. managed contract)

Naomi — can you attach the empanelment checklist and a draft SOW? Karthik — can you own the sandbox provisioning items and a quick ops runbook for field engineers?

Proposed times (PST): Tue 10/14 10:00 or Wed 10/15 15:00. Pick one and we'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Draft-SOW-BR-2025.docx (placeholder)

--
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@blueridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner empanelment + tooling access (BRC x Redwood)

Hi Samir / Jonas —

Attached is the Redwood Empanelment Checklist (PDF) and a redlined draft SOW for a standard integration + 2-day enablement workshop. High-level notes:
- Typical timeline from kickoff to field-ready is 3-4 weeks for a single POC cohort (access + training + one joint lab)
- Sandbox provisioning: we can provide a shared sandbox in us-west with preloaded sample datasets; for full isolation we recommend dedicated environments (details in checklist)
- Training: we have three paths — self-serve labs (2 hrs), instructor-led 1-day bootcamp, or 2-day immersion with shadowing. Pricing bands are in the SOW.

I've also uploaded a short ops runbook for field engineers to the Drive link below (provision details, common troubleshooting steps, token rotation reminders). Karthik will coordinate the temporary service accounts.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBRCEmpanelment

Attachment: Redwood-Empanelment-Checklist.pdf, Draft-SOW-BR-2025.docx

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Partner Enablement Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Thanks Naomi — this is exactly what we needed.

Quick confirmations:
- We'll take the 2-day immersion + shadowing for two engineers and one SA (estimated start: week of 10/27)
- Please provision sandbox in us-west and a temporary service account for testing. I'll send the list of names by EOD today.
- Procurement: we'll need the SOW in DocuSign for signature and PO routing internally. Can you route to procurement@blueridge.com when ready?

On scheduling: Wed 10/15 15:00 PST works for the intake session. Please send the calendar invite.

On a related note: do you have a short joint customer-facing one-pager we can include in our SI toolkit? If yes, can you attach?

—Samir
